name: Pen-led stroke
visual_intent: A line is drawn by a visible moving point (a pen tip, a heartbeat, the full stop of a sentence), so the viewer reads the line as an action with a direction rather than a reveal.

performance_characteristics.memory_profile: Low; about 60 tiny attribute tweens per second of drawing for the dot (estimate)

implementation_summary: Dash-offset draw of the path (visible length = L x ease(progress)) plus a dot whose cx/cy follow piecewise-linear tweens sampled evenly in time and in arc length at the same eased progress, so it stays on the tip within about a pixel. No MotionPathPlugin, no callbacks.
runtime_api: Studio.draw.pen(tl, path, at, {duration | speed, ease, dot, dotRadius, dotColor, keepDot, rate})

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test: dot within 1.5 px of the drawn tip at 8 sampled times, hidden before the stroke, ends on the path end, in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
